hero.title: The Engineering Team Behind the Repairs, Sales & Skolar
hero.subtitle: Innovatech Engineering Solutions is a Cameroonian technology company built on hands-on skill and long-term trust.

story.title: From Repair Bench to Software Platform
story.p1: Innovatech Engineering Solutions started with a simple frustration: too many good devices were thrown away over fixable faults, and too few local companies could be trusted to fix them properly. We built a team of technicians who repair electronics the right way — down to component level when needed — and sell devices people can actually rely on.
story.p2: That same engineering discipline led us into software. Today, Innovatech is the parent company of <1>Skolar</1>, a school-management platform we designed, built and continue to maintain — proof that the same attention we give a soldering iron, we give a codebase.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To make reliable technology — repaired, sold, or built — accessible to every home, business and school in Cameroon.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the engineering company African institutions and individuals turn to first, for hardware and software alike.

promise.title: Our Promise
promise.text: Transparent pricing, honest diagnostics, and a warranty that means something — every single time.

howWeWork.title: Real Diagnostics, Not Guesswork
howWeWork.p1: Every device that comes to our bench is diagnosed at component level before we quote a price. It's the same rigor our software team applies to a client's codebase — understand the root cause first, then fix it properly.
bullets: Transparent, itemised quotes before any work begins
Warranty on every repair and every device sold

team.title: A Team of Technicians, Engineers & Builders
team.p1: From repair technicians to full-stack developers, our team shares one standard: do it properly, explain it honestly, and stand behind the work. Many of us also build and maintain Skolar day-to-day — so the company that fixes your phone is the same one shipping software used by real schools.

innovationHub.title: Beyond Repair: We Design & Build
innovationHub.p1: No, we don't just repair electronics — we conceive them. Our innovation hub is where our engineers prototype custom circuits and IoT devices for clients who need something built from scratch, not bought off a shelf.
innovationHub.p2: From a Raspberry Pi proof-of-concept to a working sensor network, this is the same team, the same bench — just pointed at building something new instead of fixing something broken.

device-repair.title: Phone & Gadget Repair
device-repair.summary: Screens, batteries, ports and software faults fixed fast — for phones, laptops, consoles and smart devices.
device-repair.description: From a cracked screen to a phone that won't charge, our technicians diagnose and repair smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles and smart-home devices. We use genuine and high-grade parts, and most common repairs are completed the same day.

electronics-repair.title: Electronics & Hardware Repair
electronics-repair.summary: Hands-on circuit-level diagnostics and repair for TVs, appliances, and other electronic equipment.
electronics-repair.description: Our engineers go beyond the surface — tracing faults down to component and circuit level for televisions, home appliances, power units and other electronic equipment that others give up on.

software-development.title: App & Software Development
software-development.summary: Custom software, mobile apps and web platforms — built and maintained by the team behind Skolar.
software-development.description: We design, build and maintain software for businesses and institutions — from mobile apps to full web platforms. Skolar, our flagship school-management platform, was built and is maintained by this same engineering team.

electronics-sales.title: Sales of New & Fairly-Used Electronics
electronics-sales.summary: Verified, tested phones, laptops and gadgets — new and fairly-used — with warranty on every unit.
electronics-sales.description: Every device we sell — new or fairly-used — is tested and verified in-house before it reaches you, backed by a warranty and after-sales support from the same team that repairs it.

design-conception.title: Design & Conception
design-conception.summary: Custom hardware design and IoT prototyping — we don't just repair electronics, we conceive them.
design-conception.description: Beyond repair and resale, our engineers design and prototype custom electronics — from circuit-level conception to working IoT devices — for businesses that need a solution built from scratch rather than bought off the shelf.
